chapter: Bennie Moten, Basie and the Reno
title: Jimmy Jones, a young pianist at the Yellow Front
summary: Goodwin remembers the young Jimmy Jones as a great pianist who played the Yellow Front.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: Who played piano: the pianists musicians remembered

blocks.x: Well after he got here he didn't want to leave because he could gather up a whole lot of -- there was a lot of things going on. There was a little guy where -- we had mentioned a place called the Yellow Front. There was a little guy down there, young fellow, very young, Jimmy Jones, which God rest his soul, he didn't live very long, but that little guy was one of the greatest piano players.
Was he playing at a joint downtown?
He was playing at the Yellow Front.
Boy, that must have been quite a place.
Oh it was. See all the musicians --
